name: Purchase Order
definition: Document issued by a buyer and containing the details of a purchase, including description of goods, transport information, payment terms, etc.

Product.name: Product
Product.definition: Specifies the items which are sold by the seller to the buyer in a commercial trade.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification of the purchase order that can be used for reconciliation or to link tasks relating to the commercial trade.
